header.title: Pulse
header.scope: Oct 2026 vs Oct 2025 · Whole agency · 5 people

kpis.label: Utilisation
kpis.no_change_reason: Not recorded for Oct 2025: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: Utilisation
info.definition: Standard hours (all but production-day hours) as a share of capacity, for the people with capacity in the period. Nothing logged is "No data", never a good figure.

kpis.label: On-time delivery
kpis.no_change_reason: Not recorded for Oct 2025: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: On-time delivery
info.definition: Tasks that reached Approved in the period with a due date, and were finished on or before it, as a share of all of them.
info.formula: on time ÷ approved with a due date

kpis.label: Overdue
kpis.no_change_reason: Not recorded for Oct 2025: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: Overdue
info.definition: Open tasks (neither Approved nor Closed) past their due date at the end of the period.
info.formula: count of open tasks with due date < period end
info.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.

kpis.sub: Open and past their due date

kpis.label: Free hours, next 8 weeks

info.name: Free hours, next 8 weeks
info.definition: Capacity in the next eight weeks less booked work (remaining estimates on dated, assigned tasks and upcoming retainer cycles) and likely deals, floored at zero person by person and week by week.
info.formula: Σ weekly max(0, capacity − booked − likely)
info.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.

kpis.sub: After booked work and likely deals

kpis.label: Burnout risk
kpis.no_change_reason: Not recorded for Oct 2025: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: Burnout risk
info.definition: People above their whole weekly capacity for at least the number of weeks running set in Settings, in weeks ending inside the period.
info.formula: count of people with ≥ N consecutive weeks of standard hours > weekly capacity
info.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
